#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::cin >> input;
    int count = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
        int runLength = 1;
        while (i + 1 < input.length() && input[i] == input[i + 1]) {
            runLength++;
            i++;
        }
        if (runLength % 2 == 0) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << count;
    return 0;
}
